caption:
Mr Turtle binged a whole series from the end of the couch with his head turned to the TV, and now his neck won't turn the other way.

Holding your head turned to one side for hours can leave your neck muscles tired and stiff. Turning your body or the couch to face the screen, and swapping seats now and then, may help.

Hybi's tip: get up and walk between episodes, and slowly turn your head each way five times.

Arm tingling, dizziness or headaches are worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio
